examples.title: Identifying a Right Angle
examples.problem: Check if the corner of a square piece of paper is a right angle.
steps: Look at the corner where the horizontal and vertical edges meet.
It looks like an 'L'. This is a right angle (90 degrees).

examples.title: Angles in a Clock
examples.problem: What kind of angle do the hands of a clock make at 3 o'clock?
steps: This forms a perfect 'L' shape. It is a right angle.

examples.title: Bigger or Smaller?
examples.problem: Is the angle of a wide-open book bigger or smaller than a right angle?
steps: If the book is open wider than the 'L', it is 'More than a right angle'.
If it is closed more, it is 'Less than a right angle'.
